author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Run 7: Synergistic cAE Embedding + SOTA Graph
abstract:
This submission tests a synergistic architecture combining my novel non-linear embedding with
the previous SOTA's graph construction. A Conditional Autoencoder (cAE) generates a
batch-corrected 60-dimensional embedding. This embedding is then fed into the proven,
sophisticated graph correction utility (`build_corrected_graph`) to generate the final output.
This hybrid approach aims to get the best of both worlds.
